# Fresh Look: Old Dyes
Fresh Look: Old Dyes updates the dye textures (using the pre-1.21.9 style). The dyes are now brighter, and the ones that previously shared the same shape (lime, gray, purple, magenta, and pink) have received their own unique textures.
